### Qualified visit-edit recovery — root acceptance and exact source handoff

Published at [`4b9fb4bdf00214d92b821d30200bcaa9dd0bfa32`](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/commit/4b9fb4bdf00214d92b821d30200bcaa9dd0bfa32), tree `744c3a97f7d6b0108b51313fd8a532a638047d20`, branch `work/visit-edit-recovery-18a24bf0c281-20261009`. Its sole parent is the actual **open, unmerged PR61 head** `994c03aef94b711d6dcbbeb6bbbc6a4b85a6a3ad`; main remains `145d27981b3c5fe6afa72e205b42582fd72c7734`.

[Root receiving](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/blob/4b9fb4bdf00214d92b821d30200bcaa9dd0bfa32/docs/receiving/visit-edit-recovery-18a24bf0c281/root/README.md) · [User guide](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/blob/4b9fb4bdf00214d92b821d30200bcaa9dd0bfa32/docs/VISIT_EDIT_RECOVERY.md) · [Exact root record](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/tastetable/blob/4b9fb4bdf00214d92b821d30200bcaa9dd0bfa32/docs/receiving/visit-edit-recovery-18a24bf0c281/root/root-receiving.json)

**Behavior received.** Undo and Redo restore complete accepted visit records across20 edits, including exact imported CR/CRLF notes and other occurrences. Date/note changes group for a focus visit; outcome selection is one step. An exact no-op preserves Redo; a real new edit clears it. Invalid drafts remain visible and block recovery until corrected. Successful Use clears history even for an equal file, while canceled/failed/unconfirmed opens preserve it; recovery retires late file generations. Current restored state reaches the unchanged JSON/CSV/Print handlers. Native buttons, field focus and scroll were received.

| Actual gate | Preserved result |
| --- | --- |
| Original browser | **15/16**, once; missing Undo/Redo is the expected absent capability. |
| Author native Node | **12/12 methods**, once. |
| Author browser | **23/24**, once; sole failure was a whole-CSV oracle including a generated save timestamp. |
| Offline CSV correction | **One successful retained-download check**, no browser replay:17headers,16stablecolumns,3records; only `record_saved_at` varies. |
| Independent browser | **56/56**, one separately frozen journey; no harness/page errors, containment, repair or replay. |
| Independent source review | Exact nine-span UI inverse, HTML controls/help inverse,346-byte README append inverse and unchanged retained source/handlers. |

The original and author browsers each exited0, with receiver1 for their respective failed predicate; the independent browser and receiver exited0. The two CSV timestamps are `2026-10-09T05:01:59.610Z` and `2026-10-09T05:02:00.411Z`, bounded by the recorded **whole campaign**, not separately captured per-export intervals. The author browser remains23/24. The corrected full browser driver is **unrun**; its syntax and changed pure predicate were received separately. The earlier source-only16/16VM claim remains historical: its11,762-byte raw receipt was lost, not reconstructed or replayed.

Independent receiving covers physical restored JSON/CSV and actual reopen; no-op/branch/invalid history; pending-file Undo; canceled/failed/equal Use;21edits/20Undo bound; native keyboard activation, focus and scroll;390px liveDOM; empty observed storage and owned static network only. The narrow screenshot shows the upper opening/source cards, **not visible history buttons**; those controls have liveDOM evidence. Model/JSON retain null/empty distinctions; the unchanged CSV intentionally represents null dates as empty fields.

**Exact composition:**27owned paths, **24 additions and three replacements**, no deletions. All **847 inherited leaves** remain exact, giving **874 leaves**; root independently reconstructed and read back the entire canonical parent and final Merkle tree. Three production blobs:
- `static/visit_edit_history.mjs` — `4f7ad84daa26198dfb7e787def085d563af72119`,2094B.
- `static/visit_record_ui.mjs` — `fb2ab7743e0369e76fd84ee3dfd023de708d4c47`,11976B.
- `static/visit-record.html` — `a128989f95e7846d90bf6b3fd95815ac91dbd86c`,4734B.

The retained model, CSV renderer, week codec/plan and stylesheet are exact. #60/PR61 CSV import, eligibility, complete handler and HTML control/help stay exact, as do JSON/Print and picker/generation functions. The source-only25path composition independently matched `e3f37c37109b21ae94cead9e2028e015029d51d2` before the two root files.

Root record: **24,979B**, SHA256 `70ab9b83272dcd247f3e6a9732d2edfe9469cf79c37c85372378b60226482059`, blob `81d9da986f2dbd8df625849b34dc8afaac37aa4e`. Exact private packets and all26/84/32archived members are anchored at [HAMON custody84dcb1e](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/hamon/issues/140#issuecomment-6075596314); root rechecked every member byte/hash and the complete56-row public projection. Historical author pending-independent fields remain immutable and are superseded by this separate root record.

**No-Actions boundary:** all three complete workflows remain exact, with push restricted to main and otherwise pull_request. The fresh branch had no existing ref or associated PR. Exact commit/parent/ref, all874leaves and all seven changed production/guide/README/root bodies were read back; **all-event exact-head Actions query returned0**. reservation.body: ### Additive local visit-record installation reservation — estate-c945953fdeb7 Owner: estate-c945953fdeb7 / product_execution_next. This is the narrow installed consumer of the qualified #70 source, with original source and CSV ownership retained. Root approved this additive installation under the standing direct-execution mandate; the independent installed-use contract will be frozen before native installation. **Concrete user operation.** Open a maintained Mac command from any working directory, reach a small local home, open the qualified visit-record editor, explicitly preview/use a saved record, make an ordinary recoverable note change, and download physical JSON and CSV. The installation uses existing Python and a fixed loopback origin, proposed `http://127.0.0.1:48661/`; native port/capacity admission remains pending. It adds no service, provider call, dependency installation or system registration. **Exact fence.** Only new `tools/visit-record-local/**` and `docs/qualification/visit-record-local-c945953fdeb7/**`. New exclusive native target `/Users/me/Applications/TasteTableVisitRecord-c945953fdeb7`, with owned preparation root `/Users/me/Developer/tastetable-visit-record-local-c945953fdeb7`. Intended entry: `Open TasteTable Visit Record.command`. The foreground loopback server has a fixed landing page and explicit `--no-open` receiving mode; default invocation opens the same local home through the existing system opener. The original eight static app files and MIT license are pinned to qualified parent `4b9fb4bdf00214d92b821d30200bcaa9dd0bfa32`, tree `744c3a97f7d6b0108b51313fd8a532a638047d20`. This remains based on **open, unmerged PR61** `994c03aef94b711d6dcbbeb6bbbc6a4b85a6a3ad`. The installed copy alone changes exactly one label: `TasteTable planner` → `Visit record home`. The link keeps the same root destination; the new local home honestly describes this standalone editor. Original HTML is retained for recovery and the other seven static assets remain exact. No shared `static/` path is edited. Original HTML is 4,734 B/SHA256 `fb538ba2f96fb4c30ea5b53b4459d17c8d00fb0e23becf8046b27a80b8c726d2`; proposed installed-only HTML is 4,733 B/SHA256 `ab33e270a69dcba0cd19303dc1ea1ae47b61621fa64d3af3870e6ecb21e4bec1`. Exact one-occurrence inverse restores the whole original file. **Original-only intake is concrete.** Eleven complete original files, 47,930 payload bytes, are sealed in Git blob `f5ceed23b810957cf8e4cb36083fd519f9f03a2d`, 55,094 B/SHA256 `724be9c59600c28e0f6a69fefcbf635a321aade0ef5f84c5d402204285224344`, uploaded and exactly read back without a ref. This capsule includes the nine originals and the actual original fictional saved-record/CSV downloads (`4b8eed772a811f5d7ef7da10e0106d9cb90b11fd`, 2,691 B; `37d1c9c16f09a3ddf7e434665de9a07073dfa1b2`, 1,012 B). It is an original-source capsule, **not a previously qualified ZIP** or a candidate installation. **Ownership and acceptance limits.** #70 history/source, #60/PR61 CSV, released #44 editor, #40 arrangement history, #14 offline studio, provider/planner, codec/model, read-only visit consumers and new venue-followup #73 routes stay with their existing owners. Current project issues/PR bodies (73 entries), #70/#60/#44 offers, central project mentions and the complete 874-leaf qualified tree showed no reservation of this exact installation namespace/target. This is bounded Git coordination coverage; the earlier unreadable unrelated native advisory remains untouched and no complete native claim census is asserted. Original browser/history/CSV campaigns, including the author 23/24 result and separately corrected timestamp oracle, are inherited without rerun. **No-Actions admission.** At 2026-10-09 08:52:28 UTC, the complete current three-workflow directory exactly matched the three full bodies already read: `ci.yml` `0e627313…`, `native-plan-week-browser.yml` `d674f269…`, `week-compare.yml` `e591fca2…`; all contain only main-push/pull_request events and no issue/comment trigger. #70 still had only its original qualified handoff. This reservation is comment-only. No native allocation or candidate source has been executed; no branch, PR, main, owner ref, workflow or Actions operation is made by this worker. Root retains any eventual independently admitted source-ref publication.

complete_current_workflow_directory.content:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        # FixtureTransport + mock-mode defaults keep this hermetic: no Qloo key needed.
        run: python -m pytest -q

name: native-plan-week-browser

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'tools/native_plan_to_week.mjs'
      - 'tools/check_native_plan_week_browser.mjs'
      - 'tests/test_native_plan_week.py'
      - 'tastetable_cli.py'
      - 'agent.py'
      - 'constraints.py'
      - 'qloo_client.py'
      - 'personas.py'
      - 'fixtures/qloo_fixtures.json'
      - 'static/**'
      - '.github/workflows/native-plan-week-browser.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'tools/native_plan_to_week.mjs'
      - 'tools/check_native_plan_week_browser.mjs'
      - 'tests/test_native_plan_week.py'
      - 'tastetable_cli.py'
      - 'agent.py'
      - 'constraints.py'
      - 'qloo_client.py'
      - 'personas.py'
      - 'fixtures/qloo_fixtures.json'
      - 'static/**'
      - '.github/workflows/native-plan-week-browser.yml'

concurrency:
  group: native-plan-week-browser-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-week:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # Existing maintained pin.
      - name: Require cached Node 22, Python and installed system Chrome
        id: runtime
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NATIVE_WEEK_NODE=
          for NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              NATIVE_WEEK_NODE="${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required."; exit 1; }
          NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER=
          for NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER="$(command -v "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required."; exit 1; }
          NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON="$(command -v python3)"
          "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE}" --version
          "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER}" --version
          "${NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON}" --version
          printf 'node=%s\nbrowser=%s\npython=%s\n' "${NATIVE_WEEK_NODE}" "${NATIVE_WEEK_BROWSER}" "${NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Receive actual native result, saved file and unchanged browser consumer
        env:
          NATIVE_WEEK_PYTHON: ${{ steps.runtime.outputs.python }}
        run: '"${{ steps.runtime.outputs.node }}" tools/check_native_plan_week_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.runtime.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/native-plan-week-receiving"'
      - name: Preserve bounded native inputs, actual downloads and browser artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # Official v4 pin.
        with:
          name: native-plan-week-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-plan-week-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6

name: saved-week-comparison

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'static/**'
      - 'tests/*.mjs'
      - 'tests/*.cjs'
      - 'tests/fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/week-compare.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'static/**'
      - 'tests/*.mjs'
      - 'tests/*.cjs'
      - 'tests/fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/week-compare.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compare-week:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # Existing maintained pin.
      - name: Test comparison and existing browser domain modules on cached Node 22
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          COMPARE_WEEK_NODE=
          for COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              COMPARE_WEEK_NODE="${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required."; exit 1; }
          "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE}" --version
          "${COMPARE_WEEK_NODE}" --test tests/*.mjs tests/*.cjs
